description: Festival Playlist structure for Forza Horizon 6
howItWorks: Monthly rotating selection of challenges. Unlocked at Yellow Wristband. 4 seasons per Series (Summer→Autumn→Winter→Spring), each 7 days. Resets at 14:30 UTC every Thursday.

challengeTypes.description: 4 chapters, typically requires owning a specific car. Reward: 25,000 CR + 5 pts
7 challenges (one per day). Reward: 5,000 CR + 1 pt each
Capture a photo of a specified car/location via Horizon Promo
Solve a photo clue to find hidden treasure
Collect a specified number of items
Matchmade co-op championship vs Unbeatable Drivatars
Custom player-generated game modes and courses
Speed Trap, Speed Zone, Drift Zone, Trailblazer, Danger Sign
Time Attack or Drag Meet targets
Single or co-op championship vs Average Drivatars
Post a clean lap on a specific circuit
